senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. צרר, אצר)to preserve, guard.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 91b:11">B. Bath. 91ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>היוצרים</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 4:23">I Chr. IV, 23</cite>) <he>שנָצְרוּ שבועות וכ׳</he> who guarded their father’s oath (of abstinence).
<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:7">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>נְצוֹר תורתי וכ׳</he> keep my law in thy heart.

<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>נצור לשוני מרע</he> guard my tongue from evil. Tanḥ. B’midbar 13 <he>עד היכן נְצָרָן</he> up to what degree did He guard them?; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:3">Num. R. s. 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 140:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXL</cite> <he>רצונך שאֶצָּרְךָ נצור וכ׳</he> if it is thy desire that I guard thee, guard thou my law; a. fr.
